questions.text: How are empty parts of the text box handled (blank lines, ';;', a trailing ';', a part with only spaces)?
options: Reported as an error row (please give the message in a comment)
questions.reason: REQ-277 open question. The single-entry expander (REQ-276) rejects an empty entry, and the source documents do not say what an empty part between separators means.

questions.text: Is there a limit on how many entries one text box can hold?
options: No limit beyond a total text size (e.g. 10,000 characters)
Yes, a maximum number of entries (give the number and the message in a comment)
questions.reason: REQ-277 open question. Today the API accepts at most 500 characters for one entry; the request size and the error shown over the limit depend on this.
questions.answer: Yes, a maximum number of entries (give the number and the message in a comment)

questions.text: When are the expanded results shown?
options: On an explicit action (an Expand/Review button), as today for one entry
questions.reason: REQ-277 open question. The brief says the user 'reviews the expanded entries, then saves them' (REQ-278), but not when the review appears. Live expansion needs debouncing and changes the UI and API call pattern.
questions.answer: On an explicit action (an Expand/Review button), as today for one entry
